content.text:
Excellent! The issue is fixed. The problem was floating-point precision errors when converting prices to cents. When you passed 39.95, JavaScript's math computed it as 3995.0000000000005 instead of the exact integer 3995.

I added `Math.round()` to three functions that convert prices to cents:
- `parseEuros()` in money.js
- `cellCents()` in money.js  
- `decimalCommaToCents()` in locale.js

This ensures floating-point rounding errors are rounded away, so prices are always stored as exact integers. All prices (including 39.95, 12.99, and 10.99) now work correctly.
